caption: The drawing depicts a single, translucent glass bowl positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The bowl is rendered in light blue tones and has a flared rim, narrowing toward the base. Its form includes slightly iridescent, wavy detailing around the lower section, with the light blue shading emphasizing the glass’s transparency and thickness. The base of the bowl is circular but wider than the foot, and subtle highlights and shadows convey the reflective and refractive qualities of the glass. The only other marking is text reading “ALVIN SHIREN” in the lower-left corner of the image.
title: Bowl
